method: Read-only source review of app import preview, session replacement, save/reopen/report lifecycle and relevant core transaction/tests. No app automation, no new tests run, no proprietary target execution in this review.
status: No blocking integration defect identified in reviewed source. The low-priority row wording observation was resolved by the parent.

findings.observation: Rows with an importedTrackID are labeled Audio · restored even though the imported Track only has its name/identity and default settings, with no recovered audio clips.
findings.impact: The report elsewhere explicitly says track skeletons and lists all omitted event/mixer/timebase state, so this is not a hidden loss. The individual row is less precise than those qualifications.
findings.recommendation: Use Audio · skeleton restored or similarly explicit wording for imported audio rows.

resolution.method: Read-only verification of the exact updated row expression; GUI validation remains parent-owned.

checks.assessment: inspectCPRProject only assigns the preview. Cancellation clears it. Active project, root, media, undo state and playback are not replaced by inspection. Confirmed import first runs existing unsaved-change handling.
performCPRImport passes the preview SHA into importProject. Core rereads and requires matching digest before staging; it does not import a different source silently.

Core requires a new destination, writes source/report/project into sibling staging, validates loaded project and preserved source hash, then moves the whole staging directory. The session replaces active state only after successful return; failed imports retain the old project.

Successful import stops old transport, resets playhead via stop(), clears undo/redo/waveforms, and sets selection from the new project before rebuilding waveforms. Scheduled playback refresh is cancelled by stop(). Nothing claims restored playback clips.

Normal Save writes Project.json and leaves Compatibility untouched. Save As copies every nonmanifest child, including Compatibility and Media, into a new destination before saving the current manifest; errors remove only the newly created destination. The in-memory compatibility baseline remains appropriate after subsequent edits and renaming.

load validates the project and compatibility report before replacing session state. compatibilityReport checks regular unredirected files, exact source digest/sections, supported schema and fresh full interpretation equality. The historical sheet explicitly describes its import baseline and warns Rebase edits may differ.

Only confirmed audio track names become editable empty tracks. Non-audio classes remain reported as not restored. Preview lists event/media/MIDI/plugins/mixer/routing/automation/coordinates/signature/layout omissions, default48k/4-4/mixer/timebase, and missing-media dependencies. Track skeletons cannot be mistaken for imported audio clips in the actual timeline, whose count remains zero. The row-level wording observation is retained above.

remaining_validation: Parent-owned native GUI validation must exercise preview cancellation, unsaved-project replacement choices, import, edit/save, Save As, reopen, and report display. This source review is not evidence those UI actions ran.
Runtime Cubase import/playback compatibility, media resolution, clip placement, event timing units and source mix fidelity remain unestablished.
